messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High error rate and serving node restarts in rack-5c. Alert: gdr_timeouts x 120 in 5m, container restarts on serve-prod-5c-*. Escalation policy: oncall pager -> maria (oncall).
maria (oncall): noticing increased 5xx and tail latency for model /v1/generate from 5:12 -> 5:20. Some pods showing CUDA OOM in logs. Starting triage.
ash: can you post the alert graph? also are we seeing infra-level drops?
maria (oncall): attaching quick graph (copied): cpu ok, network tx drops up in rack-5c, retransmit count jump on ib0.
ash: +1 on rdma retransmits. Running `rdma_stat -p` now.
ash: output snippet:
```
peer 10.1.5.12: retransmits: 143, rnr_naks: 0, rx_drops: 92
peer 10.1.5.13: retransmits: 2, rx_drops: 0
```
ash: looks asymmetric, one ToR uplink flapping.
taylor (runtime): heap/kv-cache pressure + delayed kv cache eviction when packets drop. Some requests accumulate and then OOM on allocation in cudaMalloc. Stacktrace snippet: `LLMRuntime::KVCache::alloc -> cudaMalloc -> out of memory`.
maria (oncall): impact: ~12% of requests return 5xx, several customers reported slow responses. Carlos, do we have customer-facing notes?
carlos (support): posting short status: "We're investigating increased errors affecting a subset of requests in US-west. No data loss. Next update in 30m."
sophie (sre): mitigation options: 1) route traffic away from rack-5c (soft-fail routing), 2) reduce kvcache size on active models, 3) temporarily cap batch size to avoid allocations. Recommend 1+2 now.
maria (oncall): starting rollout: set routing policy for prod to avoid zone rack-5c with `redwood route set --exclude rack-5c --policy soft-fail`
ash: doing quick fabric probe: `ibdiagnet -v -t 10` -> seeing link flaps on switch sw-5c-1 port 3. Suspect firmware bug causing duplicate packets/reorder.
taylor (runtime): while we shift traffic, I'll push a runtime patch that lowers default kv cache waterline for hot models: `KVCACHE_MAX_BYTES=0.7*default` and restart pods gradually. This should avoid immediate cudaMalloc spikes.
maria (oncall): executing route change now.
incident-bot: Route change applied, percentage shifted: rack-5c traffic -> 6% remaining (gradual).
ash: out of precaution I'm cordoning affected nodes in rack-5c: `kubectl cordon serve-prod-5c-*` and evicting non-critical workloads.
sophie (sre): Also disable multi-path ECMP for the affected ToR temporarily to force single path while team engages network. Config sample to run on switch (network team):
```
switch# configure
no ip multipath ecmp 16
interface Port3
 shutdown
no shutdown
exit
```
(This forces a port reset and should clear tx reorder).
ash: network team confirmed planned emergency port reset on sw-5c-1 port3 in 5m. Expect short connectivity blip.
maria (oncall): plan: 1) shift traffic away (done), 2) reduce kvcache and cap batch (taylor doing), 3) reset port (network), 4) monitor customer impact, 5) handoff in 45m.
taylor (runtime): began kvcache env change rollout to 20% of replicas -> logs show fewer cudaMalloc spikes already. Example log after change:
```
[05:28:41] runtime: KVCache under_limit=true allocations=2 cudaMalloc_ms=12
[05:28:42] runtime: alloc_ok
```
maria (oncall): network port reset scheduled now. Expect nodes to briefly drop. Executing.
incident-bot: Switch sw-5c-1 port3: admin reset executed by network-ops.
ash: observing flaps clear; retransmits falling back to baseline. `rdma_stat -p` now:
```
peer 10.1.5.12: retransmits: 3, rx_drops: 0
```
ash: good signal.
ash: uncordoning nodes and letting autoscaler rebalance.
maria (oncall): reintroducing rack-5c to route pool slowly.
incident-bot: Traffic shift: rack-5c -> 25% now.
sophie (sre): keep an eye on CUDA OOMs, but initial signs: no new OOM errors for 10m.
ash: follow-up: we see one lingering container crash related to a GPU driver preemption, collecting logs.
taylor (runtime): remedial change: lowered max_batch_tokens in runtime config for older model variants that still hit memory peaks. Pushed canary.
carlos (support): customer update: "Issue partially mitigated; errors reduced. Full recovery in progress. Apologies for the disruption"
maria (oncall): summary for postmortem note: root cause: intermittent ToR port firmware bug causing packet reorder/retransmit -> RDMA retransmits -> KVCache eviction delays -> bursty allocations -> CUDA OOMs and container restarts. Immediate mitigations: routing away from rack, switch port reset, reduce kvcache waterline and batch size, cordon/evict false-positive nodes.
sophie (sre): actions to follow: 1) network to replace/firmware upgrade sw-5c-1 port module, 2) runtime: make kvcache waterline adaptive to retransmit signals (follow-up RFC), 3) infra: add health probe for RDMA retransmit thresholds to trigger automatic soft-fail routing.
maria (oncall): handing off to ashok for next 45m. ashok, you're pager. Please take over and post timeline updates every 30m.
ash: acked, taking pager.
incident-bot: Handoff recorded: from maria to ashok at 05:52 UTC.
maria (oncall): final note: removal of rack-5c from primary routing reduced customer impact immediately. We'll schedule a postmortem with network + runtime next steps. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
